in_sanskrit.name: गणेश्वर
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of the Ganas (group of deities)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गणनायक इश्वर (Gana-nayaka Ishvara) - The Lord of the Ganas (group of deities)

in_hindi.name: गणेश्वर
in_hindi.long_meaning: परमपूज्य (Parampooja) गणेश (Ganesha) के पदशाही (Padshahi) - The revered ruler or king of Ganesha

in_tamil.name: கணேஷ்வர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: கணேஷ்வர் (Ganeshvar) இல்லோர் (illaiyor) - The lord of Ganesha

in_marathi.name: Ganeswar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganeswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ganeswar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Gana' meaning group or assembly and 'Isha' meaning lord. Ganeswar is thus known as the lord of all beings, the primal creator of the universe, and the remover of obstacles.

in_bengali.name: Ganeswar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ganeswar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Ganeswar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Gana' meaning group or assembly and 'Isha' meaning lord. Ganeswar is thus known as the lord of all beings, the primal creator of the universe, and the remover of obstacles.
